*Repo-hunt list as of 2026-09-30 — 23 packages still looking for source.*

hey all — I'm Tom. I keep a community map of the Bend package ecosystem (https://github.com/lilalittle/bend-packages) and some of the most interesting packages on BendHub have **no public repo linked** — which means we can't audit them, contribute fixes, or fully rely on them.

If you authored any of these — or know who did — drop a link? And if you publish packages, adding a `Source:` link in your hub description helps the whole ecosystem find your code.
